IncidentDef.label: flesh burrow emergence
IncidentDef.letterText: The ground has given way, opening a narrow shaft into the dark. Damp air rises from below, heavy with rot and mould — the smell of something that died long ago and never quite finished rotting.\n\nThis is what has been calling you. A dead flesh colony waits down there. The call has not faded: you are still drawn towards it, however hard the disgust pushes back.
